payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, in which the dopant suppresses electrolyte crossover and associated aging. Its measured gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg, while projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh. The chemistry cannot operate below 4 °C because the dopant precipitates from the negative electrolyte. An independent audit retracted the original 12,000-cycle claim; the corrected governing cycle-life figure is 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity threshold.
